en.title: Rental Information
en.subtitle: Everything you need to know about leasing at SBGP
en.leaseTermsText: We offer flexible lease terms from 1 to 5 years, with options for renewal. Custom terms available for build-to-suit arrangements.
en.rentalRatesText: Rental rates vary depending on the type of space, location within the park, and lease duration. Contact our team for current rates.
en.ctaText: Contact our leasing team for current availability and rates.
